name: Projector

variantResolution.rule: variant definitions are declarative deltas applied in canonical parent-to-child order

mergeSemantics.null: replaces the parent value with null
mergeSemantics.rule: projector JSON remains declarative data and does not acquire a programming-language operator model

result.id: canonical projector id supplied by the caller

runtime.failure: any missing, invalid or non-declarative definition fails closed; partial merged projections are not returned

recursionSafety.cycle: re-entering the same canonical projector id in one active resolution context fails
recursionSafety.depth: nested projector resolution beyond maxDepth fails
recursionSafety.unwind: resolution context is unwound in finally semantics after success or failure
recursionSafety.futureCompositionBinding: recursive/nested projector composition must reuse the active resolution context

rules: projector definitions contain data, not executable code
the domain and projector definition paths are derived from the projector id
do not store id, domain or entry when they are deterministically derivable from the canonical projector id
variant definitions contain only declarative deltas from their parent/base projector
the same projector may be composed into any number of pages or surfaces
projector resolution does not execute domain behavior
projector resolution does not grant authorization
projector resolution has no implicit fallback definition
projector resolution does not cache subject-specific protected projection data
